recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Handle any future deprecation or context change through the FHIR Extension Pack only after FHIR-56093 or another follow-up reaches a final work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-32868 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested a standard complex extension named terminology-resource-identifier-metadata on CodeSystem.identifier, ValueSet.identifier, and ConceptMap.identifier with optional preferred, comment, and authoritative components for identifier metadata otherwise found in NamingSystem.uniqueId.
initial_application: Commit 2ee2898feed9035554ffea5c8efc3f45e6f2b176 explicitly applied FHIR-32868 by adding source/codesystem/structuredefinition-extension-terminology-resource-identifier-metadata.xml and registering it in source/codesystem/implementationguide-CodeSystem-core.xml. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed this and other extension definitions from R5 core source as part of moving extensions out of core.
additional_context: The current core checkout has no active StructureDefinition for the extension, but source/oids.ini still carries its canonical OID mapping. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-terminology-resource-identifier-metadata.xml with the requested URL, active status, three identifier contexts, and preferred/authoritative/comment slices. Later FHIR-40728 was Resolved - No Change and Jan 2024 TI WGM minutes say the group voted to keep the extension; FHIR-56093 is only Triaged/Unresolved and cannot drive a source change.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the extension to core would be incorrect because extension definitions now belong in the FHIR Extension Pack, and the Extension Pack source already implements the FHIR-32868 request.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - No Change reconsideration of the same extension; TI minutes say the group voted to keep the extension and rejected deprecation.
Retracted FHIR-extensions request to broaden the context to NamingSystem and TerminologyCapabilities; it does not change the FHIR-32868 core audit.
Triaged/Unresolved FHIR-extensions request to deprecate terminology-resource-identifier-metadata; not final enough to change current source.
